text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: By chance, the members of the Gourmet Guild ran into Ruka and Illya as they prepared to depart from Landosol. All dressed in their finest attires, the six of them emanated a strong holiday spirit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルの町で偶然に出会った晴れ着姿の【美食殿】メンバーと
ルカ、イリヤ。
その周囲には華やいだ空気が広がっていた。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ruka and Illya... I had no idea you were close.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルカさんとイリヤさんって
仲が良かったんですね。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Actually, this is the first time ever we've talked properly! I looked for her after hearing there was someone in town who knows a lot about New Year's.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして二人で話したのは
ついさっきが初めてじゃがのう！
ヨリに
正月に詳しい者がおると聞いたのじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: On my part, I heard from Nanaka that there was someone looking for information related to New Year's
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちにはナナカから
正月について知りたがってる人がいる
って話が来たわけさ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Certainly, I can see you being an expert on this particular topic, Ruka.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかに、
ルカってばそういうの詳しそうね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Celebrating New Year's in such traditional clothes happens to be a custom of Togoku. Of course, being from Togoku myself, I know all about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
晴れ着で正月を祝うってのは
トーゴクの風習だからね。
トーゴクの出としては
当然知ってるさ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: You girls also happens to be wearing some traditional clothes... Could it be... that you're planning to conquer New Year's just like me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お主たちも晴れ着姿ということは……
もしや……
わらわと同じく
正月を制覇するつもりか？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: He-he-he... Actually, you might be right on the money!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ、
実はそうなんです！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: What's that?! You're planning to stand in my way? If that's the case, even if you're the Gourmet Guild, I won't show you any mercy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんじゃと！
　わらわの前に
立ちふさがるというのか。
そうとなれば
いくら【美食殿】とはいえ
容赦はできんぞ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: No, that's not what we're planning. The five of us are going on a journey to complete our osechi for the guild's New Year's party.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
違うから。
あたしたちはこれから
おせち料理の材料集めにいくのよ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Also known as the: "Gourmet Guild: New Year's Memories Operation"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『【美食殿】
思い出おせち作戦』
です！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Well, if you're not planning to be on my way, then fine... But what's an osechi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんじゃ、
違うのであればよいが……
して、
おせちとはなんじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: From the little I know, it's a festive dish suited to the New Year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お正月らしい
おめでたい料理と聞いております。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Well, that's part of it. It was originally a collection of dishes made in hopes of acquiring longevity and prosperity.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
そうだね。
元々は
長寿や繁栄を願って作られた料理を集めたものなのさ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Pecorine-san too... mentioned that it was just like a good luck charm. It seems that this osechi also arrived from the culture of Togoku.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌさんも
縁起物、
って言ってたわよね。
たしか、
おせちも元はトーゴクの文化だって。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: A lucky charm, huh... Umu. Does that imply that it's a dish brimming with special powers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
縁起物、
か……
ふむ。
それは
特別な力がある料理、
ということでよいのかの？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's right. It's a special dish that everyone eats during New Year's!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうです。
お正月にみんなで食べる特別なお料理ですよ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: In other words, if I were to eat it, my lost powers might also return... Interesting! I'll accompany you on this journey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり
それを食べると失った力も戻るかもしれんということじゃな……
面白い！　
その旅、
わらわも同行しようぞ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's great! Life is a journey, so we'll travel it better together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいですね！
旅は道連れ世は情けです！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's a good proverb to live by. So, where are you planning to go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは、
いいことわざを知ってるじゃないか。
それで、
どの辺に行こうと考えてるんだい？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: For this journey, we've been planning to visit places we've been at before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これまでに
わたくしたちが訪れたことのある場所に行こうかと。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: From the mountains to the sea to the plains in search of delicious local delicacies... We've been to truly a variety of places. And if we're talking fish, there's no fish like the one at Oma!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その土地土地の美味しいものを求めて
山から海から平野から……
結構いろんな場所に行ったわよね。
魚だったらオーマとかね！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: By Oma... do you mean that Oma known for its tasty seafood?
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーマって、
あの海の幸で有名な
オーマかい？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: You know about him...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ご存じなのですか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Of course I do. If we're talking Oma, it's like a mecca for sea fishers like myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんさ。
オーマといえば
海釣りの聖地みたいなところだからねえ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: The four of us... we went fishing in Oma for Tunnus!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしたち、
オーマでトゥンヌス釣りをしちゃいましたよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Wow, I'm jealous. I've always wanted to catch one myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ、
そいつはうらやましいね。
アタシも一度は釣ってみたいと思ってたんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Then why don't you come with us, Ruka?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならば
ルカもついてきてはどうじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Me too?
text_block_list.orig_text: アタシもかい？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Since this is a mission for osechi, I'd be more than happy to have an advisor in Togoku's culture to help us out. I'm actually worried to leave it in the hands of someone like Pecorine. ...The main worry being that she'd make an osechi out of monster food and call it a day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おせち料理だけじゃなくて
トーゴク文化に詳しいアドバイザーが
いてくれるとうれしいわね。
ペコリーヌだけに任せるのも不安だし。
……勝手に魔物料理をおせちだって言いはりそうで。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Certainly, it'd be reassuring to have Ruka-san around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
ルカさんが来てくれると
心強いわね。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: A monster food osechi sounds so tasty though... However, by using the knowledge of someone that knows their stuff I'm sure we'll eat a delicious osechi♪! I'm looking forward to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物おせちも美味しいのに……
でも、
本場の知識があれば
美味しいおせちが食べられますね♪
こちらこそ
よろしくお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: The Gourmet Guild has saved me more than once before. I don't mind giving this journey a try.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【美食殿】にはこの前助けてもらったからね。
一肌脱がせてもらうとしようか。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Now then, My Lord, the order to depart is yours alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでは主さま、
出立の号令をお願いいたします。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Umu, I concur. For this journey is a matter of the Gourmet Guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
そうじゃの。
今回はあくまで
【美食殿】の活動じゃ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...That said, I'm counting on an energetic declaration.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一発威勢のいいの
頼むよ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Well then, {0}-kun, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ{0}くん、
お願いします！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: おー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The group left Landosol and headed toward their first destination, a certain temple three girls and a boy once visited.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一同はランドソルを出立し、最初の目的地である神殿へと
向かって歩を進めていた。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: So the very first destination is a temple so that we can pray for a safe journey? But I'm with you all. Your safety is basically guaranteed already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最初に神殿に向かうのは、
旅の無事を祈るためかの？
わらわがついておるのじゃ。
無事は保証されておるようなものじゃがのう。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: From this temple, we'll gather mochi, which are known to be auspicious and bring good luck.
text_block_list.orig_text:
神殿では
縁起物のお餅をいただくのでございます。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh, so it's the part that makes up the osechi lucky charm part! That's important! After all, it may be the key to restoring my powers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
縁起物か！　
それは大切じゃの！
なにせ
わらわの力の復活の鍵となるやもしれぬもの……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, {0}... isn't this the temple where you got caught in an hardship with the girls from Twinkle Wish?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば{0}って
【トゥインクルウィッシュ】と
神殿で事件に巻き込まれたんだっけ？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Umu. Since the topic was brought up, aren't you always involved in hardships?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふうむ。
思えばお主、
いつも大変なことに巻き込まれておらんか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's {0} for you. Once the hardship's gone, the memories themselves become like a beautiful jewel.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは、
さすがはお前さんだねえ。
過ぎ去ってしまえば
みんな思い出さ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's right! I heard that back then the earthly desires themselves went out of control. How scary. ...Gummy, was it? I heard it was a big kagami mochi. *slurp*
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうでした！　
煩悩が暴走しちゃったって聞きましたよ。
怖いですねえ。
……ガミーでしたっけ？　
大きな鏡餅だったらしいですね。
じゅるり。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Speaking of earthly desires, your appetite does seem to be out of control all year long...
text_block_list.orig_text: 年中食欲が暴走してるあんたが言ってもね……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Back then, wasn't {0}-kun working hard with the girls to give Kokkoro some New Year's money?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その時は{0}くんが
コッコロちゃんにお年玉をあげるために頑張ったんでしたっけ？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: My Lord's feelings... they still make me very happy to this day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
主さまのお気持ち、
大変うれしゅうございました……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: I see! But I haven't received any New Year's money from you! Why?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃ！　
わらわはお年玉をもらっておらんぞ！
なぜなのじゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Well that's... you're not supposed to expect any, but give...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃあ
お前さんはもらう側じゃなくて
あげる側だからねえ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: New Year's money...?
text_block_list.orig_text: お年玉……？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Oh my, don't you know about it? It's a custom in Togoku, but by now it's also been passed in Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや、
知らないかい？
トーゴクでの風習なんだが
ランドソルにも伝わってるのさ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I think I recall reading about it in our travel log...
text_block_list.orig_text:
本には
書いてあった気もするけど……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, so you know about it... I was actually planning to give some to you on New Year's Day as a surprise, actually.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらら、
知られちゃったかあ……
本当は
お正月当日に渡して
驚かせようと思ってたのに。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Sheffy, fear not. We have everything prepared just for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィさま。
ちゃんと用意しておりますので
ご安心くださいませ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: We've all got a New Year's money gift ready for you! Please look forward to it♪!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしたちみんなからのお年玉の準備は
バッチリ
してますよ！
お正月は
楽しみにしててくださいね♪

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: For me... but is it okay for me to take it?
text_block_list.orig_text: 私がもらってもいいものなの？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: It's something you give to someone with the hope that they'll be healthy for the year. Make sure to accept it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一年間元気でいてほしいって思いを込めて
渡すものだからね。
受け取ってやりなよ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you, Mama... Ahem. Kokkoro-san. And everyone else, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
ありがとう、
ママ……
お、
おほん。
コッコロさん。
それに、
みんなも。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're very much welcome.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
どういたしましてでございます。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since I've heard such parental affection～
text_block_list.orig_text: 久しぶりに出たわね～

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Sheffy, you're so cute!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィちゃん、
かわいいですよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: G-Geez...! That was careless of me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もう……！
今のはつい、
うっかりっていうか……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Ah, now I see. So it is something suited to Sheffy's young age, not my own...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほどのう。
シェフィはもらえて
わらわはもらえぬわけじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it!
text_block_list.orig_text: 違うのー！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ It's fun to travel with everyone while talking like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっへへー♪
こうやってお話ししながらみんなで旅するのって
楽しいですね！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can already tell this is going to be an enjoyable trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
いい旅になりそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: A fun adventure in search of food... that is what the Gourmet Guild is all about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
食を求めての楽しい冒険……
それこそが
【美食殿】でございます。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: This is... a Gourmet Guild adventure... an adventure with everyone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが、
【美食殿】の、
みんなの冒険……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Come on, Sheffy! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
シェフィ！　
行くわよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: うん！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Bathed in the gentle winter sun, Sheffy's heart danced with joy at her upcoming journey with the Gourmets.
text_block_list.orig_text:
穏やかな冬の日差しを浴びながら
シェフィは【美食殿】としての旅に胸を躍らせているのであった。
